season_awards_and_stats#aw7.detail: Verified KXNHLADAMS is filed under season_awards_and_stats (series_assignment) and that no stage mapped the coach delta to a winner. Added stage s4 'Jack Adams coach-level choice model' (softmax over ~32 coaches with >=41 games, simulated final delta from team_season_points_distribution, 1/N ties per rules). Patched nhl.coach_expectation_delta measurement (all-coach conditional logit plus rank-ordered logit on NHLBA top-3; P_exp is computed in-house, so no archived projections are needed; MoneyPuck kept only as an optional cross-check) and added a coach branch to nhl.award_vote_share_model. Corrected s3: the electorate is the NHL Broadcasters' Association, 5-3-1 ballot, ballots unpublished (checked on NHL.com, 2026 Cooper 226 v Ruff 223). aw7 now covers only the projection-archive question. Follow-up: stale 'preseason projection' wording replaced in the coach_expectation_delta label/mechanism (patch), stage s2 and the awards required_data dataset; nhl.award_voting_rules mechanism patched to name every electorate, NHLBA included.

season_futures#sf6.detail: Fixed after the audit reopened it. archetype_patches/NHL_a.json now attaches nhl.standings_stakes (secondary) and nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing (context) to season_futures, and the record has input_audit entries for both. A new required_data entry, 'Draft lottery format/odds history and post-deadline team-game residuals', feeds both inputs. Re-patched nhl.standings_stakes: the regression is now limited to lottery seasons 2015-16 onward, earlier formats are excluded rather than imputed, and the lottery covariate is the change in expected draft slot from each season's official odds table. Re-patched nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing with per-season formats and raw_data. Odds checked on NHL.com: 2021 Buffalo 16.6% (Seattle-adjusted), 18.5% from 2022, 2 draws and a 10-spot cap since 2021. Stages s5 and s4 are wired; goalie_start_forecast is also attached.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.detail: Confirmed nhl.goalie_start_forecast defined only regular-season rotation rules. Patched its measurement with a playoff branch: a logistic starter-change hazard before game g+1 on the game-g save pct gap, whether the goalie was pulled, goals allowed, backup-minus-incumbent GSAx/60, elimination and injury flags, fitted on 2005-06+ playoff goalie logs (NHL API game type 3, Hockey-Reference). Referenced in the s1 description of unreg:playoff_series_aggregate, where it was already an input, and added to season_futures s4 input_ids (KXNHLSERIES/EAST/WEST/NHL). p5 now covers only the coefficient estimates.
